The 'A.A. in Commercial Music, Audio Production Emphasis' section (Total Units: 37) lists every closed-list course: required MUFHL 309, MUFHL 320, MUSM 110, MUSM 306, MUSM 342, MUSM 344, MUSM 350, MUSM 356, MUSM 357, MUSM 362, MUSM 366, MUSM 367, plus a minimum of 5.5 units from MUFHL 305, MUFHL 310 or 481, MUFHL 311 or 482, MUFHL 315, MUIVI 345 (1-2), MUSM 115, MUSM 330, MUSM 331, MUSM 361. MUSM 306, MUSM 357 and MUSM 367 are not on the closed list. A reviewer should fetch the certificate section to confirm whether its requirements match the A.A.
